card.title: 7th ALPINI REGIMENT
card.text: Damage dealt by this unit adds equal defense to your HQ.
card.flavorText: The 7th Alpini Regiment was first formed in 1887 and has since participated in the Italo-Turkish War, WWI and WWII. At the start of WWII the regiment was raised to four battalions and some would later serve in different theaters, but in 1940 the whole regiment was sent to the Western Alps to participate in the Italian invasion of France. That same year three of the regiment battalions participated in the Greco-Italian War, while one battalion (Val Cismon) was sent to Albania where Italian forces were suffering heavy casualties. In 1942 battalion Val Cismon was sent with the 3rd Alpine Division to the Eastern Front where it was annihilated during the Soviet Operation Little Saturn (1942-43). Meanwhile the Uork Amba battalion was fighting in the East African Campaign where it distinguished itself during the Battle of Keren. After the armistice between Italy and the Allies in 1943 remnants of the 7th Alpini Regiment surrendered to the German forces in France after a brief resistance.
